subject: Request: pilot timer safety-net — keep pilot live while PO finalizes
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@healthsys.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@healthsys.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot at risk — procurement delay, can you hold the timer?

Hi Avery,

Quick note from procurement: our PO routing is stuck in final approvals and could take 7–10 business days. Our pilot with the docs ingestion and summarization flows is mid-run and the team is worried the demo tokens will exhaust before we can sign.

Can Redwood keep the pilot environment active (or provision a short-term safety-net of credits) until the PO clears? We don't want to lose momentum with clinical users next week. I attached a one-page PO intent note from finance so you can see the timeline.

We appreciate any short-term flexibility — we expect to sign a 12-month Dedicated contract once procurement finishes but need to keep the trial live to finish validation.

Thanks,
Jordan Mills
Director, Platform Engineering
HealthSys
[Attachment: PO_intent.docx (docx)]

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@healthsys.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot at risk — procurement delay, can you hold the timer?

Jordan — thanks for flagging and sharing the PO intent. Sorry to hear procurement is slow.

We can provision a provisional safety-net while PO routing completes. Proposed approach:
- Temporary credit grant: 1,000 dev credits (sufficient for ~48 hours of high-usage demo or a week of light exploratory runs).
- Conditional window: credits active immediately and expire in 14 days unless PO is received/signed.
- If you need more runway, we can escalate an additional 2,000 credits subject to Sales Manager sign-off.

Camila, can you confirm whether a model-variant switch or token cap would let us stretch the credit pool without changing the customer experience? Marcus, copying for quick approval of the provisional grant.

Jordan — if that works, reply with the approximate token burn per workflow (or attach the usage snapshot) and we can turn this on today.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood-inference.com
Phone: (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@healthsys.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@healthsys.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot at risk — procurement delay, can you hold the timer?

Avery — that proposal sounds reasonable. I pulled a quick usage snapshot from our test env and attached it. Our daily spike for the physician demo is about 220k tokens (mostly generation + embeddings). Non-demo runs are much smaller.

If you can kick on the 1,000 provisional credits now that would keep the interactive demos going through the end of the week. We'll continue to push procurement — Tara is the procurement contact and will follow up on the PO routing.

Thanks for the quick response.

—Jordan
[Attachment: usage_snapshot_aug04.csv (csv)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood-inference.com>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@healthsys.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot at risk — procurement delay, can you hold the timer?

Jordan — quick technical note from the SE side. Given the usage pattern you shared (~220k token spikes):
- Short-term steps to reduce burn without impacting demo quality:
  • Switch to quantized medium-accuracy variant for bulk embedding runs (reduces per-token cost ~2.2x).
  • Enable prefix KV caching for the demo prompt so repeat context is not regenerated.
  • Cap interactive sessions to 3 concurrent users during demo windows.

I can apply the model-variant switch and caching rule in the sandbox in 20 minutes if you give me a go-ahead. That would stretch the provisional credits significantly.

Also recommend we provision the 1,000 provisional credits now and monitor consumption hourly. If we see sustained higher burn, we can request Marcus to approve the additional 2,000 credit uplift.

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood-inference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@healthsys.com>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@healthsys.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot at risk — procurement delay, can you hold the timer? — APPROVED (conditional)

All — OK to proceed. Approvals:
- Grant 1,000 provisional credits to HealthSys immediately.
- Condition: credits expire 14 days from activation unless a signed PO is received.
- If burn rate exceeds threshold (450k tokens/day sustained over a 24-hour window), sales should pause grant expansion and notify finance.

Avery — please activate the credits and add the HubSpot deal note (HS-48291). I also linked the DocuSign envelope below so procurement can sign the Master Service Agreement quickly once they have the PO.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-48291
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embedded?envelopeId=123456789

Jordan — appreciate the prompt heads-up. Camila — please implement the low-cost config change and monitor usage; report back in this thread every 12 hours while the provisional credits are live.

Marcus Lin
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com
[Note: finance will invoice against PO once signed]
